notes: The 0.01 rad entry tolerance is a conservative project gate, not a UBTECH certified limit.
Passing this contract only qualifies an input for fresh shadow inference; it never authorizes robot motion.
A checkpoint target is never reinterpreted as a delta and is never clipped to pass the command limit.
